about: ViscNet predictions of the MYEGA parameters for the fragility section: log10 η∞ (Pa·s), Tg (°C, where η = 10^12 Pa·s) and fragility m, each with a 95% Monte Carlo dropout band (mBand, TgBand). named are the bench presets plus silica and B2O3; sweeps add one oxide in place of silica to window glass (x in mol%); melts match public/data/sciglass/fragility.json by id. Compositions in mol%, in the order of `oxides`.

model.name: ViscNet
model.cite: Cassar D.R., ViscNet: neural network for predicting the fragility index and the temperature-dependency of viscosity, Acta Materialia 206 (2021) 116602, doi:10.1016/j.actamat.2020.116602
model.licence: Numbers computed with GlassPy (GPL-3.0-or-later); no GlassPy code or weights are included. Compositions from the bench and from SciGlass (ODbL 1.0).
